summary: CourseAssessment is an entity for managing course assessments, including creation, updating, deletion, searching, and validation. It organizes assessment templates, assessor and subject types, timing controls, visibility permissions, and business validation for course-related assessments.
purpose: To store, retrieve, manage, and validate course-related assessment configurations in an academic or training system, enabling workflows for assessment administration and actor participation.

business_rules: Assessor and Subject visibility of answers controlled by respective boolean fields
Assessment open and close timing can be configured relative to course start/end
Descriptions and codes support locale (default or alternate)
If AssessorTypeCode equals SubjectTypeCode, SubjectTypeDescriptionFormatted is set to '(self)'
OpenDaysAfterStart or CloseDaysAfterEnd = 0 maps to Start_Date or End_Date respectively
If AssessmentTypeCode is 'Interim', close days formatting uses Start_Date; otherwise End_Date
validations: InterimWithoutFinal (flag indicating an interim assessment is present without final assessment)
AssessmentMaximumExceeded (flag indicating assessment count exceeded maximum allowed)
calculations: OpenDaysAfterStart and CloseDaysAfterEnd are formatted based on values and assessment type
Negative values for days produce a formatted string with '-' and absolute days
conditions: Locale determines which description field to use (default or alternate)
If OpenDaysAfterStart or CloseDaysAfterEnd == 0, formatting is different
system_behavior: Procedures abstract SQL, actions performed via DB layer
Assessment search returns entity mappings for UI or logic
Validation returns business flags for enforcing assessment constraints
dependencies: AssessorTypeCodeID and SubjectTypeCodeID reference codes for role type
exceptions: AssessmentMaximumExceeded flag may signal workflow constraint violation
InterimWithoutFinal signals missing final assessment when interim exists
